WHAT YOUR VISITORS GET

A familiar icon.
A personal experience.

Visitors click this icon to open the existing 45-setting panel. Website content and accessibility controls keep working together.

Things to keep in mind

  • Use the exact website domain registered in your account.
  • The script should be added before the closing </body> tag.
  • Payment must be completed to generate a live website key.
  • Deploy AccessEase on public HTTPS before installing on live websites.
Website security policy

Allow your AccessEase server in script-src, connect-src, img-src and font-src. The widget needs its inline styles allowed by the host policy. Caption and media features still depend on the host website’s media tracks and browser support.
